csv_project_name: Consultant Bicycle and Pedestrian Network Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The Delaware Department of Transportation (DelDOT), the Wilmington Area Planning Council (WILMAPCO) and the New Castle County (Delaware) Department of Land Use, are seeking proposals to create a program of improvements for Northern New Castle County, which is comprised of the area north of the of C & D Canal. The primary objective of this effort is to perform a comprehensive evaluation of bicycle and pedestrian connectivity in the study area and develop a master plan of short- and long- term improvements to enhance safety and support economic growth.
csv_disciplines_requested: Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning

project_location: Newark, Delaware, USA; northern New Castle County north of the C & D Canal
project_scope: Comprehensive evaluation of bicycle and pedestrian connectivity in northern New Castle County and development of a master plan for short- and long-term improvements to enhance safety and support economic growth. No specific bridge spans, building areas, or structural quantities are stated.
services: Planning/master planning, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a planning/master planning assignment, not a structural or bridge design tender.
- The scope focuses on network connectivity, safety, and program development rather than design of specific structures.
- The notice does not identify any bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or building project.
- Pure urban/open space and planning-focused tenders are not a target area for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The tender is for a master plan and program of improvements only, with no defined construction measures, quantities, or technical parameters that would allow a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a planning/master planning procurement without a defined engineering scope for structural design, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: planning/master planning, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, transportation planning. No explicit minimum reference requirements or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
